name: Turkey Sandwich Bento Box with Cheese-Filled Celery Sticks, Dried Cranberries & Goldfish Crackers

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash, dry, trim, and fill celery sticks with spreadable cheese. Cut crosswise into 2-inch pieces and place in the medium compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ stick celery
3 tbsp spreadable cheese, garden vegetable-flavor

instructions.primary_message: Place cranberries and crackers each in their own small compartments of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup dried cranberries
¼ cup goldfish cheese crackers

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.) Thinly slice tomato.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tomato
1 cup spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place bread on a flat surface; spread one slice with mayo and the other slice with Dijon. Layer turkey, tomato, mixed greens, and cheese over one of the slices. Close with the second slice of bread, then cut in half. Place sandwich in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 slice white bread
2 tsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
113 g oven roasted turkey breast, sliced
2 slice Muenster cheese, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
